paragraphs: Rabbi Alexandri bar Chagri (Metzora Rabbah, section 19: bar Chanai; Midrash Chazit on “His head is finest gold,” the same subject: bar Chadrin). Rabbi Alexandri the kerova say, etc. Mattanot Kehunnah: he was a prayer leader reciting liturgical poems.
